title: YouCoded brand — the whole set as picked, for your sign-off

steps.headline: Seen together, is this the YouCoded brand?
steps.changed: Every piece you picked across rounds 5–18, on one page: app icon, grey version, installer, the icon in six themes, and the logo on light and dark.
steps.notice: This is the first time all of it appears together.
steps.risk: A "no" here with a note is fine — say what feels off and it goes back into a round.

steps.headline: Is this the app icon?
steps.changed: White glass tile; the face shows your theme's picture at heavy blur, each theme's eye colour, a thin theme-coloured rim, shadow all round, and the medium soft smile.
steps.notice: It re-dresses itself in every theme.
steps.risk: At 16px the smile shrinks to a dot; the eyes carry it.

steps.headline: Is this the grey version?
steps.changed: The same face on mid-grey glass, with the smile added to match the app icon.
steps.notice: For dark taskbars and dark pages.
steps.risk: The smile on the grey version wasn't asked for — say no if it shouldn't have one.

steps.headline: Is this the installer icon?
steps.changed: The app icon's face, straight and slightly smaller, rising out of an open glass box with wide flaps, a download symbol and three short streaks, on the colourful background. Smile added to match.
steps.notice: The installer and the app now share the same face.
steps.risk: The smile on the installer wasn't asked for — say no if it shouldn't have one.

steps.headline: Do the lockups work with this icon?
steps.changed: Your approved L1 redrawn with the final icon.
steps.risk: The "yc" initials tile (bottom right) is still the older style and doesn't match the icon yet.

steps.headline: Do the colour versions work with this icon?
steps.changed: Your approved L2 with the final icon, including its theme versions.
steps.notice: Name colours are your original purple-to-pink and ink.

steps.headline: Are the rules still right?
steps.changed: Unchanged from what you approved, shown with the final icon.
steps.notice: Clear space, minimum sizes, colours, type, don'ts.

steps.headline: Does it all work in use?
steps.changed: Your approved L4 with the final icon on the site header and hero, app title bar, browser tab, help pages and footer.
steps.risk: The title-bar icon is 18px, where the rim, eyes and smile are at their smallest.
